articles.title: BOJ’s Hawkish Hold: Another 2026 Hike Is Still on the Table
articles.claim_summary: The Bank of Japan maintained its policy interest rate in a hawkish hold, projecting core inflation at or above 2% through its entire forecast horizon with upside price risks. Despite an apparent downgrade to near-term inflation caused by temporary government subsidies, the central bank's underlying policy outlook remains unchanged, keeping additional rate hikes through 2026 on the table.

findings.reason: The article confirms that the BOJ holds rates as underlying inflation aligns with its 2% target, supporting the claim that the central bank's underlying policy outlook and inflation trajectory remain aligned with expectations.

articles.title: Global Financials 4Q26 Outlook: Good Banks, Bad Bargain; Maintain 2.0 Stars
articles.claim_summary: Global financials face limited upside heading into 4Q26 due to mature bank margins, moderating loan growth, and high valuations, supporting a maintained 2.0-star Unattractive rating. Outperformance within the sector is expected to be limited to selective opportunities in investment banks, life insurers, and Japanese banks.
